new_candidates.legal_basis: Ordinance Imposing Temporary Moratorium On The Development of Data Centers, adopted and recorded by the Board of Commissioners
new_candidates.trigger: Bar the acceptance, processing, or approval of applications and permits, including improvement location permits, for data centers and appurtenant facilities in every zoning district of unincorporated Miami County while permanent regulations are drafted
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-07-31. The Plan Commission favorably recommended a permanent regulatory ordinance on 2026-05-13, and a June 8, 2026 public hearing took comment on the draft. The Board of Commissioners noticed consideration of a permanent zoning ordinance for its 2026-07-20 meeting, describing the temporary moratorium as still in effect since May 4; no adopted July ordinance or termination of the moratorium was located in sources reviewed.
new_candidates.outcome: Board of Commissioners adopted an open-ended temporary moratorium effective on adoption; the county subsequently held hearings on a permanent data center ordinance (May 13, June 8, and noticed for July 20, 2026) without a confirmed final vote as of this research date.

evidence.supports: Text of the adopted ordinance establishing the open-ended pause on data center applications and permits in unincorporated Miami County, effective upon adoption and running until the zoning ordinance is amended.
County page tracking the moratorium and the parallel permanent-ordinance process, including the July 20, 2026 meeting notice describing the moratorium as still in effect since May 4.
